__meta.what: Golden file for the seeded generator (src/core/rng.ts). DET-1 and DET-4.
__meta.why: xoshiro128** is implemented with JavaScript bitwise operators, Math.imul and >>> 0. If any of those behaved differently on another host every hazard roll, every raid interception and every remainder tiebreak would diverge, and replay - the thing that makes the permanent record trustworthy - would be worthless.
__meta.cross_platform: This file IS the cross-platform contract for DET-4 on randomness. A Linux CI run disagreeing with these integers is DET-4 firing.
__meta.how_raw_is_read: int(2**32) returns a draw unmodified: floor(2**32 / 2**32) * 2**32 === 2**32, so the rejection test never fires and no bits are folded. It is the only unmodified view of next() the public surface offers.
__meta.regenerate: The hand-authored columns are the oracle. To add a case: write it here with a deliberately wrong derived value, run the matching test in test/core, and copy the expected value out of the failure. Never paste engine output in without checking it against arithmetic you did yourself - that turns an oracle into a snapshot of a bug.
